channel.title: Jeff Geerling
channel.description: Father, author, developer, maker. Sometimes called "an inflammatory enigma".

videos.t: Exploring Myth: Theseus and the Minotaur
videos.desc:
FROM THE PRODUCERS OF 'DUEL OF THE SEMINARIANS...' 

Join narrator Nigel Cranberry (a.k.a. Mike) on his journey though the ancient mythological story of the yarn-toting Theseus, the courageous Minotaur-slayer from Athens. Learn about Minos, Ariadne, Paciphae, Asterious (the Minotaur), King Aegeus and everyone's favorite hero, Theseus (played by Brian).

This was actually a video we made for our Mythology class. We tried to have fun with ideas from Peter Ustanov videos and videos with Bill Moyers interviewing Joseph Campbell on George Lucas' ranch.

videos.t: iBook G4 - Hard Drive Replacement
videos.desc:
Watch as Jeff performs surgery on his iBook G4, replacing the stock 40 GB hard drive with a new 5400 rpm 60 GB hard drive, using instructions from www.ifixit.com. The whole operation took less than 90 minutes, and only one screw was missing at the end (luckily the screw didn't matter too much).

The computer booted up immediately after Jeff restored the information from the old hard drive to the new using Mac OS X's Disk Utility and an external 2.5" USB 2.0 hard drive enclosure.

The operation required a #0 phillips screwdriver, a Torx T8 screwdriver, and a mini flat screwdriver and putty

videos.t: Cube Runner Game on iPod Touch
videos.desc: I have the iPod Touch OS 2.0 update installed, and you can see a game of cube runner on the Touch. I think this game is pretty fun (especially since it's FREE), and it shows how good the accelerometer controls are on the iPod Touch and iPhone/iPhone 3G!

videos.t: A Crazy Grackle Squawk
videos.desc: Watch the 'common grackle' do it's crazy squawk sound. I always love watching the funny things birds do, and grackles can do some interesting things. When a grackle does this loud squawk, it seems that his whole body kind of blows up like a balloon - all his feathers are pushed out, and he makes a quick screech sound.

videos.t: Formula Firebird Engine Knocking (D90)
videos.desc:
*WATCH IN HD!*
Click on the link below to watch this video in HD:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4bBlPzM7Wjo&fmt=22

My brother's 1992 Formula Firebird (5.0 L 305) engine started knocking yesterday, so I took my D90 and took a quick little video of it. The engine's in pretty sad shape, but hopefully will be fixed up in a few days.

I've been using the D90 as a handheld camera a little bit here and there, and I think I'm pretty safe in saying it's not meant to be a HandyCam replacement. I'll be testing it more in a film-like environment later, mounted on a tripod with nice lighting; I hav

videos.t: The Good Warriors of the Net - IP for Peace
videos.desc:
A corny, but incredibly funny video of how the Internet and networking works from the Ericsson MediaLab. The video was made in the late 90s using pretty rudimentary computer animation, but for any tech head, that matters not. The Router, with his collision-prone tendencies, will make you chuckle. Those pesky AppleTalk packets will slow down your network. And beware the Pings of Death!

I just found the video on my hard drive in an archive folder; I think my Dad gave it to me on a CD sometime around 2000. It is not only a pretty good overview of networking terminology and functionality, but als

videos.t: 91 T-Top Formula Firebird - 5.0 305 V8
videos.desc: My brother's Formula. Has a lot of custom gear inside, including air intake, hedders, Edelbrock 360° intake, dual exhaust, and about 500 other little mods. Real American steel, and it handles great. It has the 305 V8 engine, and has a lot of blood, sweat and tears invested in it.

videos.t: Fireworks - Grand Finale at Fair St. Louis
videos.desc: High Definition video of the fireworks for Saint Louis' "Fair St. Louis" celebration at the Arch. Shot from the third floor of the building at 1 Memorial Drive on a D90 in HD mode. Not the best audio quality, but the video's pretty good! The biggest problem was that the wind blew all the cloud towards us, so a lot of the fireworks were obscured.

videos.t: Videos from Around Roma
videos.desc: A quick series of videos taken from the Trevi fountain and Saint Peter's square. Mostly, I was testing the Canon PowerShot G11's video capabilities (it's GREAT for outdoor video, pretty good for low-light/indoor video). Look for more at www.lifeisaprayer.com!

videos.t: Rome, Italy - the Eternal City
videos.desc:
Clips of video from portions of the Eternal City, Roma, Italia. Video included from St. Peter's Basilica and Square, the Piazza Navona, the countryside, the highway, the Trevi Fountain, the Colosseum, and other random areas of Rome!

For more images, and coverage of the city, please check out:
http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/special-sections/roma

videos.t: 2000 Oldsmobile Intrigue - Overview
videos.desc: A video displaying my 2000 Oldsmobile Intrigue, which I am now selling.

videos.t: Newport Aquarium - Shot with a D90
videos.desc: The video below is a montage of clips from Newport Aquarium in Newport, KY. I finally had some time to compile the clips, and back them with some ethereal music I had sitting on my drive. The video includes some jellyfish (even a tiny one that lights up its back somehow), turtles, coral reef plants, and a few other fish, big and small. All clips were recorded with my Nikon D90 at 720p, with a 50mm f/1.4 lens (it was DARK in there!).

videos.t: Fireworks at Twin Oak Park - Shot on iPhone 4 (720p HD)
videos.desc:
Edited in iMovie on my new iPhone 4 (in about 5 minutes total!), these beautiful fireworks were on display at Twin Oak Park near St. Louis, MO on July 3, 2010.

At the beginning, there's an evening-lit shot of my friend and his new baby. I love my new iPhone 4, and will be posting more video here as time goes on! My review of the iPhone 4 (and some other great tech products) is here: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/reviews

videos.t: Fireworks at the St. Louis, MO VP Fair - July 4 - iPhone 4
videos.desc: I shot these clips from the roof of the building at 1 Memorial Drive (KMOX/KMOV), and quickly edited them together in iMovie on my iPhone 4. Editing on the iPhone is amazingly easy, and besides not having a way to split clips, everything is easy enough for me!

videos.t: iPhone 4 - Impromptu Lapel Microphone
videos.desc: Using the included headset microphone, one can often get better audio recordings for HD and SD video on the iPhone 4. Find out more at www.jeffgeerling.com!

videos.t: iPhone 4 with External Dynamic Mic (Shure SM-58)
videos.desc:
http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/blog/2010/iphone-4-external-mic-audio

In this test, I plugged a Shure SM-58 dynamic microphone into a Samson MixPad 4 mixer, then took the Aux Send from that into the iPhone using a KV Connection iPhone to 1/8" mono female adapter.

Find out more about this setup for recording in the iPhone's built-in Camera app at the link at the top of this description.

videos.t: iPhone 4 - Recording with a Lavaliere Microphone
videos.desc:
http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/blog/2010/iphone-4-external-mic-audio

I have been looking for a great portable interview solution for both audio and video for a few years now. In the past, I've used my old iPhones for impromptu audio interviews (the built-in mic is good enough for Podcasts, and usually good enough for broadcast audio).

However, the main problem I've had with video interviews on my iPhone has been the quality of the microphone/audio. In this video, I demonstrate the use of a lavaliere microphone while recording a video with my iPhone 4's front-facing camera.

videos.t: Photo / Live-Blogging Gear
videos.desc: I grabbed my iPhone 4, plugged in my lav mic, and recorded a short clip showing all the gear I typically bring for a live event at which I'll be blogging and taking pictures. Check out www.lifeisaprayer.com for more info about the lav mic into the iPhone 4.

videos.t: Storm at Steubenville St. Louis Mid-America
videos.desc: This huge storm (with 50mph+ winds, hail, and more rain than you can shake a stick at!) hit the campus of Missouri State University just before the conference began. It was an incredible display, and it even knocked out the power for about half an hour—the band, for a while, was thinking of ways they could play acoustically, since there was little power to go around!

videos.t: iPhone 4 with Shure SM58 External Microphone
videos.desc: Visit the articles section on Life is a Prayer.com for more information - In this video, I demonstrate using the iPhone 4 with an external Shure SM58 dynamic microphone, through my iMac (using a Griffin iMic to get the mic into the computer). I'm using a KVConnection adapter to get the line-level output of the iMac down to a usable input on the iPhone.

videos.t: iPhone 4 - HD Video/Audio Recording with Audio Technica Lavaliere
videos.desc:
See: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/articles/photography/iphone-4-ipad-external-mic-audio-input

I am recording with an Audio Technica ATR3350 microphone, adapted to the iPhone 4's audio input with a cable from KVConnection (details on my blog, in the link above). You can do the same on the iPhone 3G/3Gs as well :)

videos.t: iPhone 4 HD Recording with Wireless Lavaliere Microphone
videos.desc:
More details at Life is a Prayer.com (my website) in the 'Articles' section (link at the bottom of this description).

Basically, I have my iPhone set up on a custom tripod (instructions on my website in link below), and the Audio-Technica lav mic goes into a Sony wireless pack, which then adapts into my iPhone using a KVConnection cable - you can find all the details on my website, in the articles section (direct link below).

http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/articles/photography/iphone-4-ipad-external-mic-audio-input

videos.t: iPhone 4 - Two Lavaliere Microphones
videos.desc:
In this video, I have two lavaliere microphones plugged directly into the iPhone 4 through a Monster iSplitter. Instructions can be found on my website, http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/

More on external mics (of all varieties) with the iPhone 3G/3Gs/4:
http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/articles/photography/iphone-4-ipad-external-mic-audio-input

videos.t: iPhone 4 External Mic - Shure SM58
videos.desc:
Details here: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/blog/2010/microphone-impedance-matching

Using an impedance matching transformer and an adapter from KVConnection.com, I was able to plug the Shure SM58 directly into my iPhone 4, and get pretty high quality audio. This clip is completely un-edited, straight from my iPhone, using the HD camera!

videos.t: iPhone 4 - Shure SM58 with KVConnection Cable
videos.desc:
Instructions: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/articles/photography/iphone-4-ipad-external-mic-audio-input

More: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/articles/computing/2010/iphone-ipod-digital-audio-recording-external-microphones

Basically, it's an iPhone 4 with a Shure SM58 mic plugged in through a KVConnection.com adapter cable. Details on my website in the link above.

videos.t: Canon PowerShot S95 Test Recording
videos.desc:
Watch as I test the Canon PowerShot S95 for a quick review on www.lifeisaprayer.com. The sound quality is so-so, but the picture is just as sharp as my iPhone 4, with a little less noise in darker environments.

One sad thing is that there's no autofocus when filming, so you're stuck with a fixed focus point... making this a lot less enticing as a complete walkaround video camera replacement.

videos.t: iPhone 4 $7 eBay Tripod Adapter - Review
videos.desc:
More details in my review: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/review/photography/ebay-iphone-4-tripod-stand-hol

And yes, the adapter does detach from the mini tripod, and yes, you can use it with any other tripod or tripod mount you need.

videos.t: iMac Hard Drive Replacement / DIY Take Apart Guide
videos.desc:
How to repair your iMac - More details: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/computing/2010/intel-imac-teardown-and-hard-d

In this HD video (shot on my iPhone 4!), I explain the somewhat tricky process of taking apart my 24" iMac (2.8, 2008 model) to replace the internal hard drive. Please see my website (linked above) for more details and faq's. This procedure should work similarly on other aluminum iMacs with glass fronts (although I'm a little leery of doing this on the 27" iMac!).

videos.t: EPIC Star Wars Birthday Card
videos.desc: My brother gave me what may be the best birthday card ever created. It opens up to the amazing Star Wars theme that plays during the opening scroll of Star Wars IV: A New Hope.

videos.t: D7000 with External Lavaliere Microphone
videos.desc:
Full review: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/review/photography/nikon-d7000

In this test, I use my trusty Radio Shack lavaliere microphone with my new D7000 camera. The microphone sounds excellent with the D7000's audio input (a feature my D90 didn't have), and will match up well with my other portable HD recording kit: the iPhone 4 + external microphone!

videos.t: Nikon D7000 Shutter Sounds + Quiet Shutter
videos.desc:
My full review: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/review/photography/nikon-d7000

In this video, I explore the various shutter sounds of the Nikon D7000, especially the new quiet shutter mode.

This video demonstrates the S single shot mode, the CL (continuous, low speed) mode, the CH (continuous, high speed) mode, and the Q (Quiet shutter) mode.

videos.t: iPhone 4 External Microphone Tests
videos.desc:
Details: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/iphone-mics

I test various external microphones with the iPhone 4, using adapter cables from KVConnection and VeriCorder. Listen to sound recorded from the Rode VideoMic, the Shure SM58, the RadioShack Lavalier mic, and the RadioShack handheld Mic. I also test the Sony WCS/WCR-999 wireless system with my own lav mic.

See my website (link above) for all the details, and links to places you can buy all the gear you need to do professional recording with the iPhone 4!

videos.t: Nikon D7000 External Microphone Shootout
videos.desc:
Details: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/review/photography/nikon-d7000#external-mics

Reviewed in this video: Rode VideoMic, Audio-Technica condenser lavaliere, and Sony WCS-999 Wireless system (with A-T lav instead of included mic).

Sorry about the yellow cast to the image - my office has the worst. lighting. ever.

Please check the link at the top of this description for more info, an in-depth review, and for links to the gear I used. Everything was edited in the video without modification—no sound level adjustments, no normalization, nothing. It's all straight from camera. I just used iMovie

videos.t: Trick Golf Shot - Straight Up
videos.desc: Shoot a golf ball straight up in the air and catch it (unlike what I did in this video). Simple, fun, and impressive—it just takes patience to get the two balls stacked perfectly on top of each other.

videos.t: Rectify - GAMES (Tron Legacy)
videos.desc: This scene never gets old... Rectify. Rectify. GAMES. Rectify. GAAAMES!

videos.t: Hail in St. Louis, MO
videos.desc: Hail just West of the city of St. Louis - was a bit larger than pea-size, but not as big as some parts (ping-pong size!).

videos.t: iRig mic Review
videos.desc:
http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/review/audio-and-video/irig-mic

In this video, I review IK Multimedia's iRig mic, which is a handheld condenser microphone built just for the iPhone, iPod touch and iPad. The mic works great, and is a pretty good deal. Click on the link at the top of the description for waaaay more detail!

videos.t: WYSIWYG Editing with TinyMCE on iOS 5
videos.desc: Editing rich text in Safari on my iPad 2, running iOS 5 beta6. I've tested TinyMCE, CKEditor, and a few other rich text WYSIWYG editors on a few Drupal sites, and they all work great! More info here: http://www.midwesternmac.com/blogs/jeff-geerling/wysiwyg-editing

videos.t: Fostex AR-4i for iPhone 4 - Review
videos.desc:
More info: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/ar-4i

In this video, I'm reviewing the Fostex AR-4i; the first audio interface for the iPhone 4 that allows stereo (two-channel) audio input for the iPhone 4. (All other solutions to this day required either an iPad or older-generation iPhone).

More details about the device, links for purchasing the product, and an in-depth review are provided via the link at the top of this video's description.

videos.t: Shedd Aquarium Dolphin Show
videos.desc: Part of the Shedd Aquarium Aquatic Show, held throughout the day at the Shedd Aquarium (http://www.sheddaquarium.org/). The dolphins are amazing! The show teaches you how the dolphins are trained, and also shows a few other animals as well.

videos.t: iPhone 4S 1080p + External Mic - First Impressions
videos.desc:
External microphones and iPhone 4S: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/iphone-mics

In this test recording with my brand new iPhone 4S, I test my cheap lavaliere microphone with a KVConnection adapter into the iPhone. 1080p video is crisp and clean, and this video even shows how well the sensor performs in relatively low light.

I've tested all the other microphones I've tested on the regular iPhone 4, and they all work great. TONS more information about mics and the iPhone 4S at the link at the top of this description.

videos.t: Chicago Willis Tower   SkyDeck
videos.desc: Views from Willis Tower's SkyDeck (formerly known as the Sears Tower), in Chicago, IL, USA. All video clips were taken with my iPhone 4, handheld (would've brought a Tripod if I had thought of it).

videos.t: Tying Knots on a Knot Rosary
videos.desc:
Full details: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/node/1121

Using some standard nylon twine, you can quickly and easily make a knot rosary. I show you how to simply make a couple knots and get them spaced evenly in this short video.

videos.t: GuitarJack Model 2 Review
videos.desc:
Full Review: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/guitarjack

The GuitarJack Model 2 is an excellent stereo audio interface for the iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPad, and iPod Touch. In this video, I review the hardware unit and demonstrate an XLR mic (Shure PG48), a Lavaliere mic (RadioShack lav), and acoustic guitar.

videos.t: Drupal 8 Status Update - hook_world_alter()
videos.desc:
A preview of what's planned for Drupal 8, and how you can help.

This presentation, developed by webchick and a team of other Drupal 8 developers, was given by Jeff Geerling at the Drupal St. Louis meetup on June 21, 2012.

You can view the slideshow and download the latest version from http://webchick.net/drupal-8-slides

videos.t: Catholic Diocese App in 5 Minutes
videos.desc:
More info: http://www.catholicdioceseapp.com/

Jeff Geerling describes the easy five-minute process of downloading, configuring, and building the Catholic Diocese App for iOS for your diocese or organization. In just five minutes, you can have a fully-native, easy to use app that shows your organization's locations, news, and prayers.

Visit the Catholic Diocese App website for more information, and help us make the project even better by contributing code, documentation, and information on GitHub!

videos.t: MacBook Pro NVIDIA Graphics Glitch - NVDA OpenGL Exceptions
videos.desc:
http://www.midwesternmac.com/blogs/jeff-geerling/glitchy-video-and-freezes

Many people report glitchy graphics card issues on their MacBook Pros (video gets jittery and jumpy, and the screen flashes and flickers). I've encountered this problem on my sister's MacBook Pro and wanted to document the problem here on YouTube.

videos.t: Editing the ParishData.sqlite File for Catholic Diocese App
videos.desc:
Base on the Mac App Store: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/base/id402383384?mt=12

This video explains how to load your parish or location data into the ParishData.sqlite file so the Catholic Diocese App has the proper location information for your diocese or organization.

More information: http://www.catholicdioceseapp.com/

videos.t: iPhone 5 External Microphone Reviews
videos.desc:
More information: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/iphone-mics

In this video, I review a variety of external microphones for use with the brand new iPhone 5. Using external microphones (instead of the internal mic) helps make your video and audio recordings reach a greater level of professionalism.

I review the Shure PG48 (like an SM58), the Audio-Technica ATR-3350, the Audio Technica PRO88W-R35 Wireless Lavaliere system, the Pyle-Pro PDWM96, the Tascam iXZ, the VeriCorder iPhone XLR audio adapter, and various KVConnection iPhone audio adapters.

I have been testing different microphones and aud

videos.t: MacBook Pro (Core 2 Duo) Hard Drive Replacement
videos.desc: 2008 Core 2 Duo aluminum chassis (non-unibody) MacBook Pro hard drive replacement. In this video, I show you how to remove your original MacBook Pro hard drive and replace it with an SSD. You could put a new spinning hard drive into it if you want, too, but an SSD will make your older MacBook Pro feel WAY faster!

videos.t: Baby Swings after the Rapture
videos.desc:
What it would look like in a nursery after the apocalypse. I think.

This was a very eerie scene at a local baby store.

videos.t: Audio Technica Pro 88W/R 35 Wireless Lavaliere review
videos.desc:
Full review is here: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/pro88w

The Pro 88W is a very capable VHF wireless microphone system, and in my opinion, is the best sub-$300 wireless system (for the value). This recording was made with a Nikon D7000. See the link above for a full review with much more detail and some nice pictures.

videos.t: RØDE smartLav Review - iPhone lavaliere microphone
videos.desc:
Full review: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/smartlav

The smartLav is the first purpose-built iPhone (or Android) lavaliere microphone. It has a TRRS plug so you can plug it directly into your smartphone and use it with any audio or video recording app.

In this video, I put it through its paces, and compare it to a bunch of different microphone options.

videos.t: Drupal - Helping in the Issue Queues
videos.desc:
Presentation by Jeff Geerling at the St. Louis Drupal Group meetup on April 17, 2013.

More info: http://www.midwesternmac.com/blogs/jeff-geerling/giving-back-helping-drupals

videos.t: iRig Mic Cast Review
videos.desc:
Full review here: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/irig-mic-cast

The iRig Mic Cast is a small microphone and headphone jack passthrough for recording audio on an iPhone, iPod Touch, Android phone, or tablet. It sounds pretty good, but is it worth purchasing if it is only a slight improvement over your phone's built-in mic?

videos.t: May YouTube Update & RODE smartLav Contest!
videos.desc:
Win a RØDE smartLav: https://servercheck.in/contest/smartlav

smartLav Review: http://www.lifeisaprayer.com/review/audio-and-video/rode-smartlav-iphone

Sorry I haven't uploaded a video in a while; I had to go to the hospital three weeks ago, and found out I had mono! I'm on the mend, and working on getting a few more reviews recorded. I still have a couple in the can, just waiting to be edited, too. Mono really wiped me out for a while!

Make sure you enter the contest to win the smartLav (see link at the top of the description!).

videos.t: Server Checkin Case Study - Drupal and Node.js
videos.desc: Server Check.in (https://servercheck.in/) is a simple, inexpensive website and server monitor. See how Server Check.in was built, and how it uses Drupal and Node.js together to build an easy-to-use and powerful web application.

videos.t: Drupal 8 - A Brief Introduction
videos.desc: Drupal 8 brings a lot of changes. Many standby contributed modules are now included with Drupal Core, and many small changes add up to the most exciting Drupal release yet! We'll walk through many of the biggest changes, highlighting how Drupal 8 will accelerate your web development and provide tools to make Drupal the best content management platform on any device.

videos.t: Last four points in 2014 Missouri HS State Championship
videos.desc: The last four points at the 2014 Missouri State High School Boys Volleyball Championships, held at Kirkwood High School on May 23, 2014. Lindbergh high school defeated CBC in three hard-fought sets.

videos.t: Ansible serial/forks demonstration on Cluster of 6 Raspberry Pi 2s
videos.desc:
A demonstration of Ansible's connection to a cluster of 6 Raspberry Pi servers using different serial/forks settings.

Learn more about Ansible from my book, Ansible for DevOps, at http://www.ansiblefordevops.com/

videos.t: Ansible for Drupal Infrastructure - DrupalCon LA BOF
videos.desc:
Drupal 8 makes it easy to build awesome websites. Ansible makes it easy to build awesome infrastructure.

Let's get together and discuss how you can use (and are already using) Ansible for your infrastructure, continuous integration, deployments, etc., with a focus on things like:

- Ansible for local development environments (e.g. Drupal VM, Vlad)
- Ansible on a cluster of Raspberry Pis (seriously! I'm bringing the Dramble with me)
- Ansible for provisioning and managing hundreds of cloud servers.

Jeff Geerling led the BoF, and we had a great discussion about how Ansible helps Drupal develop

videos.t: Ansible 101 - on a Cluster of Raspberry Pi 2s
videos.desc:
This video was made possible by http://ansiblefordevops.com/

In this brief introduction to Ansible, Jeff Geerling walks you through the basics of Ansible using a cluster of six Raspberry Pi model 2 B computers (a.k.a. the 'Dramble').

Mentioned in the video:

  - Ansible for DevOps (book): http://ansiblefordevops.com/
  - Raspberry Pi Dramble: https://github.com/geerlingguy/raspberry-pi-dramble
  - Ansible Documentation: http://docs.ansible.com/
  - Ansible Vagrant Examples: https://github.com/geerlingguy/ansible-vagrant-examples

See also: https://servercheck.in/blog/ansible-101-cluster-rasp

videos.t: Nginx Load Balancer Visualization on a Raspberry Pi Cluster
videos.desc:
Visualization of the two most common Nginx load balancer configurations—ip_hash and round robin—on a cluster of six Raspberry Pi 2 computers (a.k.a. the Dramble).

The top Pi is the load balancer, running Nginx, and it distributes requests to four backends—the next four Pis from the top.

Find out more at https://github.com/geerlingguy/raspberry-pi-dramble

videos.t: De Smet 2015 Game-Winning Goal against Lafayette
videos.desc: Game winning goal against Lafayette High School in the 2015 Missouri State High School championships (quarterfinal). Scored off a cross and header with about 3' to go in the second half. De Smet advances to the Semifinal round at Soccer Park on Nov. 13!

videos.t: geerlingguy - Celebrate D8 in St. Louis, MO
videos.desc: Celebrate the release of Drupal 8 (#celebr8d8) November 19, 2015, with Jeff Geerling (geerlingguy) in St. Louis, MO, USA!

videos.t: Drupal VM - Quick Introduction
videos.desc:
www.drupalvm.com

Drupal VM is a local development environment for Drupal that's built with Vagrant and Ansible. It helps you build and maintain Drupal sites using best practices and the best tools.

In this quick overview, I'll show you where you can learn more about Drupal VM, then show you a simple Drupal VM setup.

videos.desc:

The tutorial will walk you through building a local environment that includes Apache Solr using Drupal VM, then how to install and configure the modules to work with Solr to build faceted search, just like on Amazon, Zappos, Best Buy, Newegg, etc.

videos.t: Removing sticker residue from a MacBook/laptop
videos.desc:
I like putting stickers on my laptops, to make them a little more personal. But I hate removing the inevitable sticker residue after peeling off stickers before I sell or pass on my old laptop.

In this video, I'll show you my current best technique for getting residue off most metal and hard plastic surfaces. Let me know if you know of any better ways that won't mar the surface or take hours!

videos.t: Ghost in the Keyboard
videos.desc:
This is a Wurlitzer EP388 electric piano. And it sounds like there's a ghost in the wires.

I can turn it on and play, and it seems to be okay for a little bit, but it starts going into 'ghost' mode after a couple minutes, and it seems to randomly jump in and out of said mode.

Still doing some debugging to see what might be going on, but this is a bit of a mystery. One good thing is the circuits inside are a lot simpler than modern keyboards since this piano is a bit older.

videos.t: 2007 MacBook Pro Repair - Replace HDD with SSD
videos.desc:
In this video, I demonstrate how to repair a 2007 aluminum MacBook Pro 15" — the old hard drive (the HDD spinning disk type) was on its last legs, and I put in a new SATA SSD (SanDisk Ultra II), giving this decade-old Mac a breath of new life!

Sorry about some of the audio sync problems—I was having a little trouble with my recording software and the audio tracks from my two recorders were a bit out of sync :(

I'll also be posting a similar video of a 2011 15" Aluminum Unibody MacBook Pro soon!

videos.t: Clouds over partially eclipsed sun - 2017 Total Solar Eclipse
videos.desc:
As I was finishing up a sequence of shots for a composite image of the 2017 Total Solar Eclipse, I noticed a bit of cloud cover coming in. Instead of giving up on any more shots for a while, I recorded a few clips of the lighter clouds rolling over the sun.

Shot on a Nikon D750 with a 200-500mm VR lens (@ 500mm), on a Manfrotto tripod.

videos.t: 2011 MacBook Pro with Radeon GPU glitch rebooting constantly
videos.desc:
See related blog post: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2017/fixing-2011-macbook-pro-booting-grey-screen-amd-radeon-video-glitch

My sister's MacBook Pro had some serious problems; the infamous Radeon GPU glitch meant that there were numerous problems (stuck on grey screen during boot, safe boot not working, recovery mode not working, horizontal tearing, color glitching, etc.).

This was when I was about ready to throw in the towel. Luckily an SMD reset fixed this weird glitch. No idea how I caused it... I guess the moral of the story is be careful when messing with EFI firmware!

videos.desc:

videos.desc:

In this video, I show how to replace the PCIe SSD inside my 2017 Dell XPS 13 (model 9360). I put in a new 500 GB WD Blue SSD, replacing a Hynix 120 GB SSD that the laptop came with.

In the video, I highlight the most important part of the process to make sure you don't damage the back cover on your laptop—DON'T PRY FROM THE BACK!

videos.t: Wosports Trail Camera Review - Animals Near Feeders
videos.desc:
Some video clips from the Wosports Trail Camera, when it was attached to a tree near our backyard bird feeder stations. It caught the usual supects—squirrels, mourning doves, sparrows... but also a few thieves of the night! A family of three raccoons (who we'd never seen before!) came by and were caught on camera.

We have some deer and opossums as well, but they didn't make an appearance while I had the camera up.

videos.desc:

I was given this AUKEY mechanical keyboard for review, and put it through its paces for a week or so. Besides being loud, how is it? What do you think of mechanical keyboards? Let me know in the comments.

videos.desc:
Blog post: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2019/how-i-upgrade-drupal-8-sites-exported-config-and-composer

In this video, I show you my process for upgrading a Drupal 8 website's codebase, and highlight many different ways you can and should use Git, Composer, and Drupal's configuration management to make the process robust, easy, and fast.

videos.t: Basement Outlets and Electric Dryer Hookup Install to Sub-Panel
videos.desc:
This year, to prepare for a kitchen remodel which will require us to move our washer and dryer, and all kitchen appliances, I worked on building a 'temporary' laundry area in the basement, and also a place where we can plug in another appliance.

Part one is the electrical work; running a 30A 2-phase circuit for our electric dryer, and a 20A circuit for the clothes washer and another kitchen appliance (using a GFCI/AFCI breaker in my 75A Square D Homeline subpanel).

Soon I'll be working on the plumbing phase, for a new basement wash basin (with cold *and* hot water, yay!), the washer hookups,

I recorded a time-lapse of my three-room 3/4" hardwood flooring install, and narrated some of the tips and process I used to do it. From ripping out the old carpet and parquet to installing Aquabar 'B' underlayment, nailing a cleat in the middle, installing flooring, reversing the direction with a spline, finishing up the outside edges with a finish nailer, and finally completing the base molding and shoe molding, I have the whole process documented with the help of my little Raspberry Pi-p

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 1 - Set up Drupal codebase, git repo, Docker dev environment
videos.desc:
In this inaugural livestream, I set up a new Drupal project and Git repository for JeffGeerling.com, and show you how I set up a simple local development environment using Docker. I also accidentally cover up my terminal window with my face because it's the first time I've ever done a live stream :)

I will continue doing these live streams every Tuesday, and hopefully end up doing the final live production migration on YouTube soon!

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 2 - Adding modules with Composer, beginning migrations
videos.desc:
In this second livestream, we take the new Drupal 8 codebase and site we created, add required migration modules via Composer, and start working on migrating configuration and content from Drupal 7 to Drupal 8.

See more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2020/migrating-jeffgeerlingcom-drupal-7-drupal-8-how-video-series

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 3 - Migrating with Drush, exporting configuration to code
videos.desc:
In this third livestream, we began migrating configuration and content from my Drupal 7 site to the new Drupal 8 site using `drush migrate-upgrade` and `drush migrate-import`. We also exported the site's configuration to our code, and pushed that code up to our site's git repository. Finally, we worked through a few bugs in the migrate process relating to drush and to modules that were not enabled when they should've been.

See more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2020/migrating-jeffgeerlingcom-drupal-7-drupal-8-how-video-series

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 4 - GitHub Actions and Outage, Migration debugging
videos.desc:
In this fourth livestream, we tried to set up GitHub Actions for Drupal CI... then encountered a GitHub outage! So we switched tracks to running the migration again, and found that we had to install some extra modules like Taxonomy and Comment to get past those error messages. Then we tried updating the migration configuration and found that migrate-upgrade kept duplicating migrations (so we had upgrade_upgrade_upgrade_d7_thing.yml files), so we finished the episode by cleaning up the migrations a little, reinstalling the site, then running the migrations again.

See more: https://www.jeffgeer

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 5 - GitHub Actions CI and migration debugging
videos.desc:
In this fifth livestream, we installed a few new modules and re-ran a few migrations to try to get content to work correctly in the Drupal 8 site after it was migrated. GitHub was actually working today, so we were able to work on the CI process to install the site from configuration on every commit, and we now have some content ready for theming next week! Tune in next week to see how we start upgrading the theme from Drupal 7 to 8 with Twig, and see if Jeff could ever figure out what was causing the Drupal install to fail on GitHub Actions!

See more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2020/m

videos.t: How to add risers to existing stairs
videos.desc:
Do your stairs have open risers (the part under each tread)? My basement stairs did, and that made the stairs inconvenient (when you drop things, they fall under the stairs) and dangerous (my smallest child could fit right through the staircase!).

In this video, I demonstrate cutting a 1x8" board to size, pre-drilling three pocket holes and three regular holes, then screwing it into the treads. This should work for any staircase with wood treads and a little bit of a 'nose' or overhang on each tread.

Mentioned in the video - Kreg Jig K4 Pocket Hole System: https://amzn.to/2VPz7n8 (though you

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 6 - Claro admin theme, Admin toolbar, and theme migration
videos.desc:
In this sixth livestream, we set up an admin theme after discussing Seven and Claro. We added the Admin Toolbar module for a nicer admin UI experience. Then we copied the 'jeffgeerling' theme over from my Drupal 7 site to Drupal 8, and started updating the theme components like the .info.yml and CSS libraries to work with Drupal 8! GitHub Actions is running now, so every time we push a new commit it is tested in a CI environment, yay!

See more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2020/migrating-jeffgeerlingcom-drupal-7-drupal-8-how-video-series

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 7 - Local dev environment comparison, blog theming
videos.desc: In this seventh livestream, we mentioned the importance of coming together during the strange (and sometimes lonely!) times we live in with coronavirus and quarantines. We summarized a few things worked on between last episode and today, like a faster local development environment (trying Drupal VM, DDEV Local, and Symfony Local Server too!). We also ran through some pragmatic choices with regard to switching modules in Drupal 8 (and why I chose to stick with the older but working code filter module). Finally, we spent a half an hour working on making blog posts look the same on the Drupal 8 s

videos.t: Drupal 7 to 8 LIVE Migration - Ep 8 - Blog view migration and theming
videos.desc:
In this eight livestream, we manually migrated the Blog view (which included a Blog landing page, a blog.xml RSS feed, and a 'Recent Blog Posts' block) from Drupal 7 to Drupal 8. Then we worked on styling and theming the Blog landing page, incorporating a theme hook suggestion to add a 'visually-hidden' class to the Blog landing page's title so it would not display but would still be present for those using screen readers.

See more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2020/migrating-jeffgeerlingcom-drupal-7-drupal-8-how-video-series

videos.desc:
Jeff Geerling (geerlingguy) introduces Ansible in the first episode of a new live-streaming series "Ansible 101 with Jeff Geerling."

Jeff walks through installing Ansible, running tasks on a remote AWS EC2 instance using Ansible ad-hoc tasks, integrating Ansible with Vagrant to build local Virtual Machines (VMs), and then teaches you how to write your first Ansible playbook!

This video follows material from chapters 1 and 2 in the bestselling Ansible book, Ansible for DevOps.

Buy Ansible for DevOps: https://www.ansiblefordevops.com
Sponsor Jeff on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlin

videos.desc:
In this ninth livestream, we upgraded Drupal core from 8.8.2 to 8.8.4 using Composer. We also discussed some migration struggles with the naming of the database connection key (hint: it should be 'migrate'). Then we worked on theming the blog comments, and upgrading a template_preprocess_hook() function from Drupal 7 to Drupal 8.

See more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2020/migrating-jeffgeerlingcom-drupal-7-drupal-8-how-video-series
